In fact, this very repository was also written using AI. I ran this tool on a previous revision of this repository. There were 11 tests and 108 generated mutants: 73 were caught by the tests, 23 survived, and 12 failed to compile.

Ultra-photorealistic, intricately detailed horror scene depicting a vast underground catacomb beneath an ancient ruined cathedral. Endless stone corridors disappear into suffocating darkness, their walls constructed from thousands of yellowed human skulls and weathered bones. Massive stone pillars are wrapped in tangled black roots, while rusted chains hang from vaulted ceilings and disappear into pools of stagnant water. Dozens of melted candles cast weak, trembling light across cracked stone floors, illuminating disturbing symbols carved into the walls. At the centre of the chamber stands a colossal, skeletal figure draped in decaying ceremonial robes, its elongated limbs ending in crooked, claw-like fingers. Its skull is crowned with twisted iron spikes, and two tiny, unnatural points of crimson light burn inside its otherwise empty eye sockets. Around its feet, pale skeletal hands emerge from beneath the floor, reaching desperately toward the living world. Far behind it, an enormous sealed stone doorway stands slightly ajar, revealing an impossible darkness filled with countless watching eyes. Thick mist coils around the bones, and the shadows appear to move independently of the candlelight. The atmosphere is oppressive, ancient, and profoundly terrifying, dominated by charcoal blacks, bone whites, muted sepia, and isolated crimson highlights.
The entire composition forms one continuous, unified environment with no dividing line, border, or abrupt separation between photorealism and drawing. Hyperrealistic stone textures, individual bone fragments, drifting dust, and intricate anatomical details gradually merge with rough graphite sketchwork throughout the entire scene. Fine pencil strokes, frantic crosshatching, charcoal smears, scratched outlines, and unfinished construction marks become progressively more prominent toward the lower portion. The skeletal figure's limbs appear to unravel into frantic lines, while emerging hands and distorted faces materialise from incomplete sketches. A realistic female hand enters naturally from the bottom edge, holding a sharpened graphite pencil against the paper, apparently drawing the ancient doorway. Around the pencil tip, unfinished skeletal fingers seem to push through the paper itself. The lower scene dissolves into fragmented outlines, erased smudges, chaotic graphite marks, and unfinished skulls fading into untouched white paper. The transition remains organic and seamless, creating the deeply unsettling impression that the catacombs are being drawn into existence and that something ancient is using the artist's hand to escape into reality.
